pass_criteria: all 5 symbols emit >=1 tick sample per 5-minute bucket for the whole smoke window
heartbeat rows present at <= 60s cadence throughout
one complete static spec snapshot per symbol at smoke start and one at smoke end (any diff flagged, never silently accepted)
terminal_connected true for >= 28 of 30 minutes with any gap gap-recorded (missing = missing)

full_window.start_definition: first full UTC day AFTER smoke passes; declared by the Lead in the collection start manifest before data interpretation
coverage_floors: F1 per-symbol presence: >= 95% of 5-minute UTC buckets per calendar day contain >= 1 valid sample (the rollover/server-maintenance window is gap-marked and excluded from the denominator, missing = missing)
F2 session coverage: every weekday (Mon..Fri) carries >= 4h of spread samples per symbol, including >= 1h inside the London/NY overlap
F3 rollover contrast: the 20:55-01:05 UTC window is sampled on the triple-swap weekday (as served by SYMBOL_SWAP_ROLLOVER3DAYS) AND on at least one non-multiplier weekday for contrast
F4 spec stability: >= 2 full spec snapshots per symbol (window start + end), sha256-manifested; any mid-window drift is an event row, never a silent overwrite
F5 dedupe: (symbol, venue_time_msc, bid, ask) unique after verification; duplicates counted and dropped at verification only, never in the raw layer
full_window.stopping_rule: outcome-independent: stop = earliest UTC date >= start + 7 days with F1-F5 met; if unmet, continue collection (never restart clocks) or declare NOT_RUN_COVERAGE fail-closed; no result, analysis, or PnL can move it (there is no PnL anywhere in this probe)
